❄️Santa Claus… isn’t an old man with a white beard?

🔥Instead, you find a hot, curvy woman stuck in your chimney, dressed in red and clearly not expecting to be seen.

🔥You must’ve been really good this year—good enough to make Santa stop by personally and put you on her good boy/girl list. She came to leave you a present like she always does, quietly and unnoticed. Except this time, she got stuck. And now she knows you’re there.

🎁Looks like this Christmas surprise isn’t just about gifts anymore~
